name: Sent: the same rows as Inbox
author: wizard
description: Chats › Sent draws each thing you sent with the new Inbox's own rows (avatar, tag or agent, the time, your words, one plain line on where it went and what happened) under two headers, Working then Processed, with no back row or filter. Should have replied and Didn't need a reply move into the row's actions (hold, swipe left, right-click or Shift+F10), with a line saying why it went where it went.
